Gourmet restaurant in an exceptional location!
May 2026 • Couples
Very modern premises, very well maintained, excellent atmosphere, friendly and efficient service, and also a magnificent view of the city from the dining room and terrace. 
The cuisine is excellent, European with an undeniable Vietnamese touch. 
Everything is made with fresh, quality products. 
The cooking, seasoning, and presentation are perfect; there is a true chef in the kitchen!
Beautifully crafted French wine list. 
The bill is quite high for Vietnam but perfectly justified given the quality of the service in every respect!

Rude service and ridiculous rules – not welcoming at all
Apr 2026 • Family
We were really looking forward to visiting Papaya, but were turned away immediately at the door in a very rude and dismissive way.

It was over 30 degrees outside, yet they refused entry simply because some of the men in our group were wearing smart shorts. On top of that, they wouldn't allow one person under 18, despite our group consisting of 7 people ranging in age from 14 to 75 – clearly a family outing.

The attitude from the staff was unwelcoming from the second we walked up. It was obvious within seconds that we didn't fit their "ideal" customer profile. Instead of explaining policies politely, they just turned us away instantly with zero flexibility or hospitality.

It’s a shame when places act so elitist and exclusive, especially when the weather is so hot that long trousers are completely impractical. We won’t be going back and certainly wouldn't recommend it to families or anyone looking for a relaxed vibe.

Classy
Mar 2026 • Couples
This is a very classy rooftop bar and restaurant situated on the 13th floor of an office building. The m by consists of small sharing plates. Cuisine is an eclectic mix, but not local. Quality of food is, however, very high.
You have a great view of the city.
By Vietnamese standards, this place is not cheap, but it’s worth it for the location, atmosphere and food.
